cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 pattern - Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Coco-Betaine #3, refatting Glycerin #5 and Glycine Soja Oil #6; no second anionic/reset route or intent.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several routes - pearlizer Glycol Distearate #4, Glycerin #5, payload lipid Glycine Soja Oil #6 (§6 reviewed row), emollient Dicaprylyl Ether #13, late cationic polymers Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #19 and Polyquaternium-7 #22. No silicone; cationic delivery is late.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Lipid + pearlizer + two cationic polymers + humectant could be 'multiple complementary systems' (high).

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: early nonvolatile lipid Glycine Soja Oil #6 with emollient Dicaprylyl Ether #13 and pearlizer #4 interacting with two cationic polymers - noticeable but bounded residue, limited by an effective SLES/betaine base and late cationics. PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil #12 excluded as solubilizer (§6 row).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Early oil plus interacting lighter routes; reset bounds them.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no silicone, no rich 2-in-1. Low is the realistic neighbor because rinse-off oil deposition with late cationics may be slight.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: dominant exact-product positioning is a soothing shampoo for itchy/sensitive scalp ('Beruhigendes Shampoo', 'wirkt beruhigend auf die juckende Kopfhaut', 'für ... sensible Kopfhaut', ECARF) with scalpComfortTarget targeted (7.2 sensitive row).

careDirection.limitation: Primary is not a repair/moisture decision; moisture assessed as secondary.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: SLES chassis and fragrance; equal-weight moisture claim.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: buffered SLES, oat/aloe, humectant + lipid -> scalp-comfort and moisture compatible. Unblind: 'Beruhigendes Shampoo' + itchy/sensitive scalp -> scalp_active primary.

focusSecondary.rationale: moisture: distinct positioning ('spendet Feuchtigkeit und sorgt für geschmeidiges Haar', 'schenkt dem Haar Feuchtigkeit') with an independent moisture_supported route - humectant cluster Glycerin #5, Aloe #7, Propylene Glycol #18 plus emollient/deposition Glycine Soja Oil #6, Dicaprylyl Ether #13 - separate from the scalp-comfort route (oat #8, buffered cleansing) (§8, F1).

careDirection.limitation: Aloe also supports the scalp-comfort claim; rinse-off.

focusSecondary.counterSignal: Partial overlap with the scalp route (aloe).

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no daily/frequent, reset or treatment trigger ('sanft einmassieren' is a direction, not frequency).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit sensitive/itchy scalp positioning and credible supportive architecture - buffered moderate cleansing, Avena Sativa Kernel Extract #8, Aloe #7, Glycerin #5, Glycine Soja Oil #6 refatting, ECARF 'hochverträglich'. Counter-signals: SLES chassis and fragrance #27 (not a veto).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Salicylic Acid #26 alone does not count.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable; T6 applies (sensitive) but nothing is not_suited. T4: W neighbor low keeps normal ideal and raises fine; C neighbor high raises coarse -> no flags.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-SENSITIVE: E2 'sensible Kopfhaut' / 'juckende Kopfhaut' / 'beruhigt' on the exact manufacturer page (E1 moderate; canonical name has no scalp term). Formula: scalpComfortTarget targeted + prominent comfort route Avena Sativa Kernel Extract #8 (before Parfum #27) + cleansing not strong -> pass. No dry-scalp claim. Confidence = min(positioning moderate, scalpComfort moderate, cleansing high) = moderate. S-FOCUS: scalp_active primary -> no mismatch.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular (irritationen expects gentle; I2 keeps regular -> amber). I3: no cleansing neighbor -> no flag.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Product identity: canonical name 'Wahre Schätze Sanfte Hafermilch' vs manufacturer name 'Beruhigendes Shampoo Sanfte Hafermilch'; positioning confidence graded moderate (manufacturer page) because no pack front is in the packet.
E4 lists 'Avena Sativa Kernel Extract/Avena Sativa Kernel Flour'; this INCI is 'AVENA SATIVA KERNEL EXTRACT / OAT KERNEL EXTRACT' -> matched as listed.
F2 independence when one ingredient (aloe) serves both the scalp-comfort and moisture claims; treated moisture route (glycerin/oil) as independent.
